style: English, synthwave pop, confident male vocal with light reverb, analog synth arpeggios, gated drums, driving bass, bright chorus, 118 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Engine cold beneath the glow
City hums in stereo
Every signal fades to grey
I still know the way

[Chorus]
Neon garage, keep the light on
I am running till the night is gone
Turn the dial and let it ring
We were made for this

[Verse]
Static on the dashboard screen
Ghosts of every road between
Hold the wheel and count to three
Drive it back to me

[Chorus]
Neon garage, keep the light on
I am running till the night is gone
Turn the dial and let it ring
We were made for this
